text: Easier to read price history: the price now and how much it dropped sit on top, each price change gets its own space with its price, and markers no longer overlap.
The share icon on characters is now lavender, so it stands apart from the gold watch star.
Character details now show a price history chart with the first listing, relists, price cuts and the price now.
New Deal of the day at the top of Home: the best buy under $25k, with a fresh pick every midnight Pacific time.
Share any character: tap the share icon to copy or send a link that opens the site on that character.
Characters now show their real first-listed age, even if they were listed before our tracker started, with a tag-clock icon and a pink ↻ for the latest relist.
Timer: countdowns now read like a clock, and Altar of Darkness, the Black Dragon field boss and the Battlefield bosses were added. Clan Challenge was removed.
Sold prices and the price trend chart now sit at the bottom of Feed 36h.
Icons and badges now explains every icon, including the ↻ relisted marker and the Today summary chips.
Sold prices now has a weekly price trend chart by class and power, with a rising, falling or flat note.
Faster repeat visits, and the site now opens offline with the last data it saw.
Feed 36h now lets you pick the power cutoff, so you can see sales under 650k.
Browse now starts empty until you pick a filter or search, with For sale now and Recently sold sections.
Browse now shows recently sold characters XDRACO hides, with the sold price and date.
Sold prices is back to pictures only and now fits fully on your phone.
Sold prices now shows a short class name under each picture.
Sold prices now fits your phone with no sideways swipe, with short icons for changes and a legend.
The STRONG badge icon is now dark plum so it stands out on the gold.
New Icons and badges guide in How this works, Send feedback on every page, times on What's new, and the feedback thank-you screen fits iPhone.
Feedback sign-in fixed on iPhone: Google now opens in a popup.
Send feedback: sign in with Google from More or the button on Home, and tell us your ideas or bugs.
How this works now opens on its own, with no character cards underneath, and the More tab stays lit while it's open.
Close and Back now take you to the top of Home, and the Home, Tools and More bar is on every page, including Top by class and What's new.
How this works is now easy to read: short tap-to-open sections with plain bullets, and the icon credit line at the bottom is gone.
Tapping Home on a character page now takes you back to Home, and opening a tool closes the character page first.
On iPhone the tab bar and menus now sit above the home line, so the last item isn't squeezed and taps at the bottom work.
Filters+ matches on Home now say where they came from and show your active filters as small chips, with an Edit button.
Filters+ matches on Home are now simple Top 10-style rows that show only the stats you searched for. Tap a row to open the full page.
Tidier menu: swipe down to close sheets, tools open on their own, one Browse item, no duplicate links, gold badges instead of green, centered STRONG pill, and Feed now covers 36 hours.
Bottom tabs are now Home, Tools and More with new minimal icons. Tools lists every feature (Browse, Timer, Filters+, Alerts, Watchlist, Sold prices, Feed 48h, Top by class) so the page stays tidy.
New bottom tab bar (Top, Browse, More) tidies up the page. Sort, class and info options now live in the Browse and More sheets.
Newly listed autoscroll slowed to 3 pixels a second.
Newly listed autoscroll is slower and uses a smoother glide on phones.
Newly listed autoscroll is now half as fast and glides smoothly on phones.
Newly listed now scrolls slowly by itself and pauses while you touch or swipe it.
Relisted characters with a price cut now show the old price crossed out on a slim corner ribbon in Newly listed.
Top by class rank numbers now match the gold-ringed Top 10 circles.
Top 10 rank numbers now sit in small gold-ringed circles that are easier to see.
Compare now works from Top 10 character pages: tap Compare on two characters, then Compare in the bottom bar.
Newly listed 650k+ now swipes sideways through the last 7 days, with a small price-cut mark on relisted characters.
Top 10 shows a small rank number on each photo. Stale and Cutting badges are smaller.

Every card now shows how long the character has been listed. New badges: ⚡ FRESH (under 24h and already 10%+ under fair, act fast), 🕰 STALE (7+ days on the market, seller may cut or take an offer) and ✂️ CUTTING (price cut 2+ times). Fair values now follow the last 14 days of sales (shown as "market -7% vs model"), so % under is more realistic. New sort and filters by listing age.
Top by class and What's new pages now match the magenta theme. Falling petals removed.
New dark magenta theme with a banner wallpaper, glowing cards, gold accents and drifting petals.
New app icon: an anime MIR4 spirit summoner in deep magenta, searching with a magnifying glass.
New anime-style app icon: a MIR4 warrior searching with a magnifying glass.
Timer is now its own fold-out section in the features list.
Removed Clan Expedition from the Timer
Timer shows what's live now, with Spawned badges on bosses that are up
Timer adds Helbar, Rallying of Void, Redmoon Purgatory, Fury Chamber, Expedition, Domination, Clan Expedition, Clan Challenge and Server Reset
Timer now shows what's coming after the next event, so you can get ready
New Timer card: next boss and event countdown (World boss, Bicheon Heist, Valley War, Castle Siege, Magic Square and more), pick your server region
New Home Screen app icon
iPhone Home Screen app: alert banners and a fixed alert sound
Newly listed boxes now show just the $ price
Fixed: character pages always show full details, even with filters on
Filters+ now shows a Matches list right under the form
Top 10 now shows the 2 newest 650k+ listings instead of feature boxes
Fixed: refreshing no longer reopens the last character page
New Top by class page: top Taoist, Arbalist, Warrior & Lancer with class filter
Watchlist: tap a name to open the character, class pictures, and Listed now on the right
Top 10 now shows the site's 4 best features instead of the long explanation
Price drop tags now show the dollar change with a fire icon in green; price increases show in red
Header status line is now simple gold icons with numbers
Stat chips on character pages now use XDRACO's in-game stat icons
Character pages now show a History card: when they were first seen, every relist, price change, delist and sale
Times now say Today and Yesterday in the feed and history
Feed 48h shows only characters with 650k+ power, for both listed and sold
Tap a name in Feed 48h to open that character's page
Yellow Dragon Wayfarer event added (Oct 25 to Nov 8)
Magic stones with full stats, sold characters included
Sold characters' gear shows in two rows, like live listings
Spirit and gear tier badges are XDRACO style with centered numbers
Gear icons in XDRACO style, in two rows: weapon and armor, then accessories
New front page: Top 10 strongest with class pictures, tap one to open its page
Search also finds sold characters, tap one for its full saved details
Maintenance window shown (market lock 5:30 PM PT)
WEMIX price tag shows the change since 5 AM PT
Trends: monthly sold prices by power band
Compare two characters slot by slot
Value per dollar ranking and badge
Pro tools: advanced filters, watchlist, sold prices by class, 48h feed
Relist and price cut tracker with badges
Conquest, Training and Bag shown as pictures
Smarter fair value using more of each build
Build score and STRONG badge
Leaderboards, deal alerts and $25k budget filter
Full stat sheet with Gear, Spirits, Skills and Stats tabs
MIR4 deal finder launched
